findings.title: userObjectKeys mixes attacker regex with ownership
findings.description: gocyclo=18 gocognit=30. Nested scan closures, two caps (seen vs linkCandidates), and last-write-wins on linkCandidates[key]=id sit in the same function as the tenant-ownership gate. og_image_url is attacker-controlled text run through objectKeyRE; a future edit that add(key) before ownedLinkIDs (or that treats the last candidate id as authoritative) puts another tenant's object into the ZIP. The dual maxBackupFileEntries checks can also desync (candidates full, seen not).
findings.fix: Split collectLinkCandidates (regex+cap), collectNoteMediaKeys, filterOwnedLinkKeys (ownedLinkIDs then add). Keep add() as the only writer to seen. Test: foreign-id key in og_image_url must not appear; two regex hits for one key keep the owned id.
findings.impact: gocyclo=18 gocognit=30. Nested scan closures, two caps (seen vs linkCandidates), and last-write-wins on linkCandidates[key]=id sit in the same function as the tenant-ownership gate. og_image_url is attacker-controlled text run through objec

findings.title: restore parent BFS silently reparents cycles/dupes
findings.description: gocyclo=15 gocognit=27. indexByID keeps the first duplicate folder id; later rows vanish from the graph. Cycle break then walks 'first unresolved' and may assign parents[child]=&parentID after hasPendingParent flips, so a later cycle member keeps a parent that just became reachable — restore trees flatten or attach to the wrong node with no error. copyRestoreStaging feeds this slice straight into INSERT parent_old_id.
findings.fix: Split indexFolders (reject or collapse duplicate IDs explicitly), buildAdjacency, topoAssign, breakCycles (always nil the broken edge). Return (parents, warnings). Test: A↔B cycle → both roots; duplicate IDs → warning, not silent first-wins.

findings.title: updateOnce boolean soup can skip folder auth
findings.description: gocyclo=20 gocognit=24 (Update is gocyclo=18 gocognit=21). Password change, hint-only mutation, live-hint reload, and parent cycle check are four independent predicates in one tx. The live-hint reload is a 4-boolean conjunction (hintToValidate==nil && PasswordSet && newPasswordHash!=nil && !PasswordHintSet). Dropping one clause skips INV-067 (hint==password) or the bcrypt-oracle guard on hint edits, or the SERIALIZABLE cycle check.

findings.title: Validate last-write-wins URL→folder conflicts
findings.description: gocyclo=17 gocognit=33. One pass aggregates folders, unique-URLs, and tags, then mutates the same maps during the conflict query. urlFolders[it.URL]=folderPath last-write-wins, so a URL listed in two folders attributes Conflicts only to the last path; Counts.Links still counts both rows. Report lies, dry-run vs apply diverge.
findings.fix: Split aggregateItems (counts + []urls + folder→[]url), queryExistingURLs, applyConflicts, sortFolders. For duplicate URLs, increment Conflicts on every folder that listed the URL (or reject dupes up front).

findings.title: parseHead Next() inside title swallows tags
findings.description: gocyclo=17 gocognit=30. Nested tokenizer switch; case "title" calls z.Next() and drops the token when it is not TextToken. <title><meta property="og:image"…> (or comment/empty title) consumes the meta, so OG/favicon never apply. EndTag </title> consumed the same way leaves depth++ without a matching --, so later depth<=1 meta filtering drifts on malformed HTML.
findings.fix: handleStartTag / handleEndTag. Title text: only read z.Text() when the tokenizer is still on title, never z.Next() past a non-text token. Clamp depth at 0. Test the empty-title + following og:image case.

findings.title: listOwnedObjects packs every ZIP budget in one callback
findings.description: gocyclo=12 gocognit=26. WalkObjects callback inlines prefix, key-length, per-file size, entry count, expanded-bytes, and manifest-index budgets. The compare object.Size > maxArchiveExpandedBytes-maxManifestJSONBytes-databaseBytes-listing.bytes underflows to negative when databaseBytes is large (every file then fails closed) and is easy to reorder so append happens before a cap. Export (gocyclo=20 gocognit=22) already did the snapshot; this is the remaining hot gate.
findings.fix: acceptObject(object, prefix) error for shape checks; addToListing(...) error for counters. Compute remaining := max-(database+headroom+listing.bytes) once with an explicit remaining<0 reject. Test underflow and duplicate keys across prefixes.

findings.title: preview process inverted nil finishAt status machine
findings.description: gocyclo=20 gocognit=24. process leaves preview_status=pending when willTryScreenshot, then maybeScreenshot returns nil on success, error, get-preview failure, and CAS supersede — and *time.Time only on skip/capture-fail. process calls SystemFinishScreenshotFallback only when finishAt!=nil. A SystemGetPreview error therefore leaves the card on 'capturando…' forever; a reader cannot tell success from 'do not finish' from 'caller should finish'.
findings.fix: Return a three-state (finished | needsRelease | abort) from maybeScreenshot. process switches on it. Never use nil for both success and lookup failure. Test: GetPreview error after pending write must release status.

findings.title: stepUpSecondFactor Begin without local settle
findings.description: gocyclo=17 gocognit=25. Nested numeric→TOTP→email else recovery; Begin(key) is here, CommitFail only on empty proof, success returns (proof, key, true) and settleStepUp lives in password/2FA/email callers. A new step-up endpoint that forgets defer settleStepUp leaks the limiter slot (or worse, never CommitFail). Factor dispatch and limiter protocol are one function.
findings.fix: tryStepUpProof(uid, user, code) (SecondFactorProof, error) with no HTTP/limiter. stepUpSecondFactor only Begin + map error → 401 + return key. Force callers through a helper that defers settleStepUp.
